note: Single source for the slash commands. `python scripts/catana.py docs` regenerates commands/*.md and docs/COMMANDS.md from this file. Plugin commands are invoked as /catana:<name>. /catana:catana is the skill itself (the router).

commands.name: hero-shot
commands.title: Hero shot
commands.purpose: Premium cinematic still: product hero, packshot, key visual, editorial or portrait image.
parameters: subject (required): what to shoot, with material/colour/finish
platform or aspect ratio (optional; default by domain)
reference image(s) and what to preserve (optional)
examples: /catana:hero-shot matte black perfume bottle on wet basalt, moody, 4:5
/catana:hero-shot our sneaker from ref shoe.jpg floating over a neon city, keep the logo and colourway
behavior: Build the 13-field spec with `catana.py enhance` (product/fashion/food/automotive presets), add references with preserve lists
Lint (grade A/B required), pick an image provider with `catana.py select --op t2i|i2i|multi_ref_image`
Quote cost and get approval for paid connectors; generate 2–4 variations; verify and log every asset
Without a usable provider: deliver the prompt pack and say nothing was generated
limitations: Exact label/logo text depends on the model; check every output and regenerate or fix in post
Paid generation needs a connector with credits

commands.name: ugc-video
commands.title: UGC video
commands.purpose: Authentic creator-style video: AI spokesperson, talking head, unboxing, review, demo, testimonial — scripted, multi-scene.
examples: /catana:ugc-video vitamin C serum, TikTok, 25s, 28-year-old skincare creator, hook: dark spots in 2 weeks
/catana:ugc-video our budgeting app, Reels, testimonial from a freelance designer
behavior: Write the script with the UGC beats (hook, problem, product, demo, result, CTA) and voiceover direction
Plan shots with `catana.py plan new --domain ugc` (handheld phone language), fill bible (persona @id, product)
Voiceover free via VoiceStudio; spokesperson video via a connector only with approval (lip-sync is a paid step)
Compile, lint, execute or deliver the prompt pack + script
limitations: Never impersonate a real person; AI spokespeople are fictional or consented
Lip-synced talking heads need a paid connector

commands.name: faceless-video
commands.title: Faceless video
commands.purpose: Narrated video without an on-camera person: b-roll or kinetic typography with voiceover and captions.
parameters: visual style: AI b-roll, kinetic type (motion engine), or mixed
examples: /catana:faceless-video 5 money habits of first-time founders, Shorts, 45s, kinetic
/catana:faceless-video history of the Burj Khalifa, YouTube 16:9, 90s, b-roll
behavior: Write the narration (hook in the first 1.5 s) and split it into timed lines
Kinetic: build with the local motion engine (free) at the platform format; b-roll: plan shots and prompts per line
Render the narration with VoiceStudio (free) and mix it under the picture with ducking
Burn-in captions recommended for muted autoplay
limitations: AI b-roll shots need a connector (paid); kinetic/motion versions are free and local
The motion engine needs Node, Python and Chrome on the machine

commands.name: ad-multiplier
commands.title: Ad multiplier
commands.purpose: Many ad concepts and variations from one product: hooks × angles × formats × platforms, named for A/B testing.
examples: /catana:ad-multiplier Aurora earbuds, 9 variations, TikTok + Reels, commuters
/catana:ad-multiplier spring menu at our café, 6 variations, Instagram feed
behavior: Define 2–3 creative angles and 3+ hooks; build the variation matrix with a naming scheme
One spec per variation via the prompt engine; lint each
Execute the approved subset (quote the total first) or deliver the matrix as a prompt pack
Return a test plan: which variable each pair isolates
limitations: Total cost scales with variations — always quote the batch before generating

commands.name: cinematic-video
commands.title: Cinematic video
commands.purpose: Film-grade sequence: scene planning, characters, storyboard, camera direction, lighting, grade and continuity.
examples: /catana:cinematic-video a lighthouse keeper's last night before automation, 60s, melancholic
/catana:cinematic-video neo-noir chase through a rain-soaked Dubai Marina, 30s
behavior: Logline, beats, characters in the bible (@id), named grade and lens package
`catana.py plan new --domain cinematic`, fill shots with continuity (screen direction, eyelines, motivated light)
Compile → keyframe + video prompts per shot, QC, sequence continuity
Execute shot by shot (reference the previous frame for continuity) or deliver the pack
limitations: Character consistency across many AI shots needs reference images and multi-reference models

commands.name: image-to-video
commands.title: Image to video
commands.purpose: Turn a reference image into a directed video shot (optionally to a last frame).
examples: /catana:image-to-video villa.png slow dolly in, palms sway, 6s, keep the architecture exact
/catana:image-to-video day.png to night.png, timelapse day-to-night, 8s
behavior: Spec with a first_frame reference (and last_frame if given) and an explicit preserve list
Choose one primary camera move that fits the duration; one action per ~2.5 s
Lint, select provider (i2v or first_last), quote, execute, verify against the start frame
Fallback: prompt pack
limitations: Geometry and text can drift at high motion intensity — keep it low for architecture/products

commands.name: character-studio
commands.title: Character studio
commands.purpose: Create a consistent AI character: bible, turnaround sheet, expressions, and reuse across shots.
examples: /catana:character-studio Layla, 30s Emirati architect, short curly hair, linen abaya, warm confident
/catana:character-studio a small orange robot mascot for a kids' coding app, 3D animated look
behavior: Write the bible entry (identity, face, hair, body, wardrobe, marks, voice) as one locked description
Generate a turnaround/expression sheet (with approval) and save references
Reuse via @id tokens + references in every later shot; lint sequences for drift
limitations: No real-person likeness without consent
Perfect identity lock depends on the model's reference support

commands.name: product-commercial
commands.title: Product commercial
commands.purpose: Product advertising film: hook, hero reveal, macro details, use, benefit, packshot, end card.
examples: /catana:product-commercial Aurora earbuds, 15s, Reels, sleek night city
/catana:product-commercial hand-made olive oil soap, 20s, warm rustic, ref soap.jpg
behavior: Plan with the product beats; lighting recipes (rim+strip, backlit liquid, gradient sweep)
Preserve product shape/label/colour from references in every shot
Compile, lint, execute (multi-reference models for identity) or deliver the pack; VO free via VoiceStudio
limitations: Label text accuracy varies by model — verify every shot

commands.name: storyboard
commands.title: Storyboard
commands.purpose: A complete storyboard and shot list from an idea — no generation.
examples: /catana:storyboard 40s luxury villa commercial in Abu Dhabi
/catana:storyboard 30s TikTok launch for a fitness app
behavior: `catana.py plan new`, fill concept, bible and every shot
`catana.py plan compile --out dir` → storyboard.md (keyframe + video prompt per shot, timing, camera, transitions, sound, edit sequence, QC)
Offer to execute any shot or the whole board next
limitations: Text storyboard; keyframe images only if the user then asks to generate them

commands.name: camera-movement
commands.title: Camera movement
commands.purpose: Build a professional camera-movement prompt (or explain a move) from the 27-move library.
examples: /catana:camera-movement orbit 360 around a perfume bottle, 8s
/catana:camera-movement what's the difference between push in and dolly in?
behavior: Look the move up (`catana.py camera show|find`), check combinations and minimum duration (`camera check`)
Phrase it with `camera phrase` and place it first in the video prompt
Explain best use, subject behaviour, mistakes and good combinations
limitations: Models follow one or two simultaneous moves reliably; more are flagged

commands.name: architecture-film
commands.title: Architecture film
commands.purpose: Architectural cinematics and visualization: exteriors, interiors, drone, day-to-night, weather, construction-to-completion.
examples: /catana:architecture-film modern villa in Abu Dhabi, 40s, from renders in ./renders, day-to-night ending
/catana:architecture-film office tower, construction to completion, 20s, LinkedIn
behavior: Plan with the architecture beats (establish, approach, threshold, flow, detail, life, hero, end card)
Preserve massing, floors, openings, roof and camera position from references; low motion intensity; corrected verticals
Day-to-night/weather/construction as per-shot lighting overrides + transition notes or first/last frames
Compile, lint, execute or deliver the pack
limitations: AI video can still bend geometry — always check verticals and window counts

commands.name: scene-builder
commands.title: Scene builder
commands.purpose: Build a multi-scene sequence with continuity: scenes, shots, transitions and consistent prompts.
parameters: sequence description or an existing plan.json (required)
examples: /catana:scene-builder three scenes: dawn market, noon chase, night rooftop — 45s
/catana:scene-builder plan.json
behavior: Split into scenes, each with its own location/time of day; shots inherit the bible
Mark deliberate lighting changes as transitions; vary camera moves
Compile and run sequence QC (aspect, style, grade, time of day, character wording, total length)
limitations: Generation of each shot follows the provider rules (quote + approval)

commands.name: prompt-enhancer
commands.title: Prompt enhancer
commands.purpose: Turn a basic prompt into a structured, specific production prompt with a QC report.
examples: /catana:prompt-enhancer a car on a road at sunset
/catana:prompt-enhancer cinematic shot of a woman in a cafe, video, higgsfield
behavior: `catana.py enhance "<prompt>" --json`, then replace defaults with specifics the user implied
Show the before/after, the 13-field breakdown, negatives and the lint report with fixes
limitations: Defaults are good starting points, not the user's brand; ask for brand specifics when they matter

commands.name: campaign-studio
commands.title: Campaign studio
commands.purpose: Complete multi-platform campaign: concept, key visual, video spots, platform cuts, copy and a production plan.
examples: /catana:campaign-studio Aurora earbuds launch, awareness, TikTok + Reels + YouTube + LinkedIn
/catana:campaign-studio Ramadan offer for our restaurant, Instagram + Snapchat
behavior: Big idea + 2–3 routes; key visual specs; hero spot plan; per-platform cuts from data/platforms.json (ratio, length, hook, safe zones)
Variation matrix for testing; copy per placement
Quote the full production before generating; otherwise deliver the campaign pack
limitations: Platform limits change — confirm paid-placement specs before trafficking

commands.name: style-transfer
commands.title: Style transfer
commands.purpose: Apply a visual style to an image while preserving its subject and composition.
examples: /catana:style-transfer villa.jpg in the style of moody.jpg, keep the building exact
/catana:style-transfer portrait.png as a 1970s Kodachrome editorial
behavior: Spec with a subject reference (preserve list) and a style reference/description
Operation style_transfer (one style ref) or multi_ref_image; lint; select provider; execute with approval
Compare output to the subject reference for drift
limitations: Strong styles can alter identity/geometry — iterate with a stricter preserve list

commands.name: video-director
commands.title: Video director
commands.purpose: Direct a complete production from one idea: concept to final edit, with execution through available providers.
examples: /catana:video-director luxury cinematic commercial for a modern villa in Abu Dhabi, 40s
/catana:video-director 20s launch film for our AI note-taking app, with a voiceover
behavior: Deliver the 12 Director outputs: concept, visual direction, storyboard, shot list, camera moves, lighting, scene descriptions, image prompts, video prompts, transitions, sound design, edit sequence
Compile + QC; quote; execute approved shots; VO free via VoiceStudio; assemble via the edit list
Report generated vs prompt-only shots honestly
limitations: Final assembly of AI clips is an edit step (EDL provided); the motion engine can assemble type/graphics locally

commands.name: motion-film
commands.title: Motion film (Katana style)
commands.purpose: CATANA's original engine: a beat-locked, code-rendered motion graphics film cut to a music track, rendered locally to MP4.
parameters: music track the user has rights to
examples: /catana:motion-film 30s katana promo for my app Inkwell, track song.wav
/catana:motion-film vertical 9:16 hype reel of our dashboard, music ./track.mp3
behavior: Follow references/motion-film.md: scaffold, read the music, plan in beats, build shots, stills QC, render, mix, deliver
Optional free voiceover via VoiceStudio, ducked under music
limitations: No AI footage (by design); needs Node 18+, Python 3 audio packages and Chrome
Bring your own music; SFX are procedural
